tools.name: metadata-audit
tools.description: Fetch any HTTP/HTTPS URL and extract metadata leaks (HTTP headers, meta tags, HTML comments, third-party trackers). Costs $0.05 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: threat-scan
tools.description: Search the public web for mentions of a person's name containing exposed PII (phone numbers, emails, SSNs, home addresses). Costs $0.10 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: breach-check
tools.description: Keyless email breach intelligence check (XposedOrNot + HIBP) and optional k-anonymity SHA-1 password check. Costs $0.10 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: opsec-score
tools.description: Multi-vector OPSEC exposure score (0–100, grade A–F) across public web search, data brokers, paste sites, and social profiles. Costs $0.25 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: monero-opsec-audit
tools.description: Cryptonote Base58 + Keccak-256 Monero ($XMR) address/subaddress decoder (Spend Key, View Key, checksum), live Monero RingCT telemetry, EVM <-> $XMR swap correlation check, and MMR proof. Costs $0.25 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: data-removal
tools.description: Matches an authorized data-broker listing with supported removal paths and drafts a reviewable CCPA/GDPR-style request. Does not submit a removal without explicit authorization. Costs $0.50 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: wallet-opsec-audit
tools.description: On-chain Base/EVM wallet deanonymization & hygiene audit + deterministic $XMR settlement subaddress. Costs $0.50 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: full-privacy-sweep
tools.description: Combines authorized public-exposure, privacy scoring, and removal guidance into one structured report. Costs $1.00 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: cypherpunk-redteam-dossier
tools.description: Comprehensive 6-operator Cypherpunk Red-Team Dossier (Web Metadata + OSINT Threat Scan + Breach Check + OPSEC Score + EVM Wallet Hygiene + $XMR Monero Audit + MMR Attestation). Costs $5.00 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: sovereign-opsec-retainer
tools.description: Enterprise & DAO Zero-Trace OPSEC Retainer Package with $XMR Atomic-Swap Treasury Isolation Blueprint and Statutory Takedown Binder. Costs $25.00 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: spam-caller-removal
tools.description: Prepare official caller-ID unlisting and spam-label dispute steps for an authorized phone number. Does not submit requests. Costs $0.10 USDC on Base via x402.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: metadata-audit, threat-scan, breach-check · Private data: breach-check, wallet-opsec-audit, cypherpunk-redteam-dossier · Public sink: breach-check, data-removal, spam-caller-removal.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: metadata-audit, threat-scan, breach-check · Private data: breach-check, wallet-opsec-audit, cypherpunk-redteam-dossier · Public sink: breach-check, data-removal, spam-caller-removal

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
